# Generated Files

## Rule: Self-Contained

Every generated file must be understandable without external context. Include:
- Purpose statement
- Date generated
- What generated it (agent or process)
- Relevant references

## Rule: Reviewable

Use clean Markdown formatting. Make diffs meaningful — one logical change per artifact update.

## Rule: Ephemeral by Default

Unless a document is explicitly durable (like a decision record), mark it with a generation date and assume it will become stale.

## Rule: No Duplicates

Check for existing artifacts before creating new ones. Update, don't duplicate.
